title: Pre-Market Brief — 19 Nov 2026
intro: US stock futures are trading higher ahead of the opening bell, led by a strong surge in mega-cap technology shares. The S&P 500 futures are up 1.17% to 7,426.75 and Nasdaq 100 futures are climbing 2.03% to 27,740.

sections.heading: Today's calendar (CET)
sections.content:
- 🟠 14:30 · EUR ECB President Lagarde Speaks
- 🟠 14:30 · USD Philly Fed Manufacturing Index · (f 20.6 · p 20.9)
- 🟠 14:30 · USD Unemployment Claims · (f 198K · p 200K)

sections.heading: 🛢 Oil desk
sections.content: Crude oil is higher this morning, with WTI advancing 0.97% to trade at 83.11 and Brent crude gaining 1.01% to reach 90.07. Prices are drawing support from ongoing geopolitical developments and firm energy demand.

sections.heading: Market theme
sections.content: Risk appetite is firmly supported as equity indices rally alongside retreating Treasury yields and a softer US dollar. Meanwhile, volatility has dropped sharply with the VIX down 8.96% to 22.36.

sections.heading: Potential scenario
sections.content: The base case expects Nasdaq 100 futures to maintain altitude above 27,740 amid strong momentum in tech giants like Amazon and Alphabet. Alternatively, a reversal in sentiment could drag S&P 500 futures down from 7,426.75 if macro data triggers renewed rate concerns.

sections.heading: Key risks
sections.content:
- Upcoming US economic releases including Philly Fed Manufacturing and unemployment claims at 14:30 CET
- Geopolitical headlines regarding US-Russia relations and European security developments
